fields.Name: T133 - Communication Templates
fields.Description: Verifies the Communication app's Templates section renders its template list and that opening a template shows its editor/detail view without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Templates section. Confirm the templates list renders (it has many template rows), then open one template and confirm its editor/detail view appears showing the template's CONTENT — a 'Contents' section with the template Text (which may include {{ placeholder }} parameters) and possibly a 'Template Includes' area. (These are MJ Templates whose body is the Contents/Text — there is NOT a separate 'subject'+'body' field pair, so do not look for those.) Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Communication app is open with the Templates section selected
The templates list/grid renders (rows or a valid empty-state)
After opening a template, an editor/detail view shows the template's content (a 'Contents' section with template Text, possibly with {{ }} parameters or Template Includes)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
